CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Smoothly return to level flight at monster eye level.
CONTROLS.NAME: recenter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed through the monster field.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of creature animations — tentacle wave, terrain crawl, core pulse.
CONTROLS.NAME: anim_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Temporal blur — blends current frame with previous. Higher = smoother, more trails.
CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of brightness pulse on bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much the beat drives monster movement — jump, swell, and frill flare.
CONTROLS.NAME: beat_strength

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Height multiplier for the rocky ground — 0 = flat, 1 = default, higher = taller jagged peaks.
CONTROLS.NAME: terrain_hilliness

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far the renderer looks — lower values improve performance, higher values show more distant monsters.
CONTROLS.NAME: render_distance

DESCRIPTION: Fly through a towering parade of eldritch juggernauts. Original shader "Lowlands juggernauts" by evvvvil_ (CC0). Flight mechanics from Ocean Planet by RBambey.
TITLE: Monster
